sents.t: Daniela, do we really need to go through with this?
sents.zh: 达妮埃拉，我们真的要这么做吗

sents.t: You need to promise us that you'll never sneak off to the surface again.
sents.zh: 你得向我们保证，再也不偷偷溜到水面上去了
bkw: 偷偷地走；溜（sneak off 偷偷溜走）

sents.t: I'm really sorry. But, you know, it's not that dangerous up there.
sents.zh: 我真的很抱歉。不过，你们知道吗，上面其实没那么危险

sents.t: I told you. Our son has a death wish.
sents.zh: 我早就说了。我们儿子就是在找死

sents.t: But it's okay. He's one of us.
sents.zh: 不过没关系，他跟我们是一类的

sents.t: Ah, yes. There's usually a bad influence.
sents.zh: 啊，果然。通常都会有个带坏他的人
bkw: 影响；（a bad influence）带坏别人的人

sents.t: Good thing you sent for me when you did, huh?
sents.zh: 幸好你们及时叫我来了，是吧

sents.t: Luca, this is my brother, your Uncle Ugo.
sents.zh: 卢卡，这是我的哥哥，你的乌戈舅舅

sents.t: Thanks again for coming all this way on such short notice.
sents.zh: 再次感谢你这么临时还大老远赶过来

cards.zh: 偷偷地走；溜（sneak off 偷偷溜走）
cards.ex: Sneak means to go somewhere quietly so that no one sees you. Sneak off means to leave secretly.
exs: The cat sneaks into the kitchen when no one is looking.
cards.note: Day 9 原句：“You need to promise us that you'll never sneak off to the surface again.”（你得向我们保证，再也不偷偷溜到水面上去了）

cards.zh: 影响；（a bad influence）带坏别人的人
cards.ex: An influence is a person or thing that changes how you think or act. A bad influence makes you do things you should not do.
exs: Her big sister is a good influence on her.
cards.note: Day 9 原句：“Ah, yes. There's usually a bad influence.”（啊，果然。通常都会有个带坏他的人）
